facts.material: bi-metal (HSS/carbon steel) hole saws, steel mandrels and pilot drills, case
facts.function: cutting holes in drywall, wood, plastic, metal
facts.form: retail kit of several hole saws, mandrels with pilot drills, carry case
facts.end_use: hand/power tool accessory for drilling holes

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8202 covers saw blades of all kinds; chapter 82 note 1 applies (base metal working part)
GRI 3(b): retail set of goods in different headings (8202 saws, 8207 drill/mandrel, 4202 case); hole saws give the essential character

rejected_alternatives.reason: drilling tools; pilot drills and mandrels are minor, hole saws are the essential character
carry case only holds the tools and does not give essential character (shown only by search)
mandrels are not the essential component of the kit

classification.rationale: N355088 and N333439 (both in force) classify hole saw sets and kits in 8202.99.0000 under GRI 3(b), as the hole saws impart essential character. H097658 (status modified) was seen but not relied on.
